title: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's headquarters to cheers from employees and said "I'm gonna be a better CEO the second time around" (Geoff Weiss/Business Insider)
summary: Geoff Weiss / Business Insider: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's headquarters to cheers from employees and said “I'm gonna be a better CEO the second time around” — Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's Santa Clara headquarters Monday to cheers from employees, less than two weeks after his stunning ouster.
